generate_image_from_prompt: generate an image from a text prompt using the AmusedPipeline with guidance scale and inference steps
configure_micro_conditioning: configure micro conditioning aesthetic score and crop coordinates for the AmusedPipeline generation
use_negative_prompt: use a negative prompt with the AmusedPipeline to guide what to exclude from generated images
decode_latents_with_vqvae: decode latent tokens to images using the VQVAE model with force not quantize option
customize_inference_steps: customize the number of inference steps and temperature scheduler for AmusedPipeline generation
